message_preferences.greeting_rule: Always start with a polite, natural greeting (e.g., 'Hi [Name], hope you're having a great week!')
message_preferences.selective_skills_rule: Select only 2-3 most relevant skills matching the target post/role; do NOT dump all skills at once
message_preferences.active_search_rule: Always explicitly mention active search intent (e.g. 'I am actively looking for new opportunities in...')
